biggest_catch: You earn cash per short survey (no points gimmick), but survey volume is limited and TraitScore-gated — higher-paying surveys unlock only as your score rises, and the tiered cashout minimum ($15 first, then $10, then $5) plus the 72-hour payout are reported by third-party sources, not on the official homepage.
catches: Rewards are per survey with no guaranteed volume — surveys arrive as you're matched, and pay rises only as your TraitScore rises (paid per completed survey, even partial ones, per the official site).
The tiered cashout minimum ($15 first cashout, $10 second, $5 after) and ~72-hour processing are reported by third-party sources, not stated on the official homepage.
First cashout requires PayPal; third-party sources report a unique private (non-VoIP) mobile number matching your country of residence is required.
Changing registered phone number or PayPal email can freeze redemption for up to 180 days under current rules (third-party source).
The official site's own expectation-setter: even very active users make 'an extra $20 a week' — 'survey taking is not gonna support you.'

steps: Create a free account at paidviewpoint.com and tell them about yourself via the initial trait surveys (short demographic surveys that still pay).
Check for surveys several times a day — matched surveys appear on your dashboard and by email; each pays cash, even if you can't finish it.
Build your TraitScore by answering consistently and honestly; higher scores unlock more and better-paying research surveys.

Once you reach the cashout minimum (third-party sources: $15 for the first cashout, then $10, then $5), connect your PayPal (or Venmo) and transfer your money — third-party sources report payout within 72 hours.
